section.title: Operating condition(s)
section.p: The interior lamps will turn on for approximately 30 seconds with all the doors (and trunk) closed and locked.

li.p: When the touch sensor on the front outside door handle is touched
When the door unlock button on the smart key or digital key is pressed
For more details, please scan the QR code in a separately supplied Car Infotainment System Quick Reference Guide.
The infotainment system may change after software updates. For more details, please refer to the web manual in the quick reference guide.
